sources.rights: Regulatory research only; current text/applicability review pending.

sources.title: Oman MTCIT personal data governance
sources.applicability: Review permit requirements for Article 5 data including health, applicable exceptions and transfer assessment.
sources.rights: Regulatory research only; permit applicability unresolved.

sources.title: Qatar NCSA special-nature processing guidance
sources.applicability: Review health/special-nature processing permission and exact mainland/QFC regime; Arabic legal text controls over unofficial English translation.
sources.rights: Regulatory research only; permission unresolved.

sources.title: HHS resources for mobile health app developers
sources.applicability: Determine covered-entity/business-associate relationships; not every health app is automatically HIPAA-covered.
sources.rights: Reference only; no compliance attestation.

sources.title: FTC health breach notification rule guidance
sources.applicability: Assess health-app/business model applicability, including potential multiple-source capability and incident duties outside HIPAA.
sources.rights: Reference only; no universal incident deadline adopted.

sources.title: FTC mobile health apps interactive tool
sources.applicability: Regulatory issue-spotting including service claims and medical-device considerations, not a clearance certificate.
sources.rights: Reference only.

sources.title: Washington Attorney General consumer health privacy overview
sources.applicability: State consumer-health-data review is separate from HIPAA; states served still unspecified.
sources.rights: Reference only; full state-law inventory pending market selection.

sources.title: ICO special-category data guidance
sources.applicability: Identify both general lawful basis and special-category condition. Recheck guidance/commencement affected by Data (Use and Access) Act 2025.
sources.rights: Reference only; no chosen legal basis.

sources.title: EU General Data Protection Regulation
sources.applicability: Review territorial scope, purposes/bases and health-data condition, processors, safeguards, rights, impact assessment and transfers; member-state specifics remain separate.
sources.rights: Legal reference only; no compliance or representative determination.

sources.title: Supabase row-level security
sources.applicability: Owner/link-scoped database policies; a frontend filter is not access enforcement. Privileged keys require a separate boundary.
sources.rights: Technical reference only; deployed policies not inspected.

sources.title: Supabase column-level security
sources.applicability: Sensitive write-field restrictions need explicit enforcement in addition to row ownership.
sources.rights: Technical reference only; future implementation tests required.

sources.title: W3C WCAG 2.2
sources.applicability: Proposed AA target with keyboard, focus, labels, errors, reflow and accessible authentication tests; no conformance claim.
sources.rights: Reference only; no copied standard text.
